parent_evidence.evidence_ceiling: local fixed-learner Identifying-CFE mechanism evidence only

question: When predicate and policy primitives are trained separately and the exact composed task is never shown, does an identifying predicate basis improve zero-shot composition into the correct opaque action relative to a narrow under-resolved predicate basis, while policy experience and optimizer-visible mixture are held fixed?
core_composition: NUMERIC_STATE -> condition_z; condition_z + mode -> opaque_action; evaluate NUMERIC_STATE + mode -> opaque_action without exposing condition_z

policy_interface.reason: Prevent pretrained action/overflow semantics from carrying the composition.

training_geometry.update_field_rule: Every optimizer window contains exactly 4 predicate sequences and 4 policy sequences; sequence indices/order are paired-identical between arms except predicate contents.
training_geometry.target_balance: predicate 2 false / 2 true per block; policy exact 2x2 condition_z x mode factorial per block

readouts.COMPOSED_ACTION_PRIMARY: numeric state + mode -> opaque action; condition_z hidden

evaluation.interpretation_rule: Final action accuracy may not be interpreted without the paired predicate-direct and policy-direct readouts.

baseline_admission.note: Opaque action labels are intended to preserve learning headroom.

requires_all: mean paired COMPOSED_ACTION identifying-minus-narrow accuracy delta > 0
identifying arm wins COMPOSED_ACTION on at least 4 of 6 paired seeds
identifying arm improves composed accuracy on both condition_z=false and condition_z=true pooled slices
POLICY_DIRECT mean accuracy >= 0.95 in both arms

trigger_any: identifying wins fewer than 4 of 6 paired seeds
apparent composed benefit comes only from one truth side
policy-direct learning fails the 0.95 mean gate

COMPOSITION_PRESENT_BUT_PREDICATE_UNRESO.trigger: COMPOSED_ACTION improves but predicate-direct remains strongly one-sided across boundary slices
COMPOSITION_PRESENT_BUT_PREDICATE_UNRESO.disposition: do not promote a clean boundary/compiler law; next work remains predicate-field resolution

preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_BRANCH_IF_SUPPORTED: Only after hostile interpretation: design a fresh-domain composition/transfer replication or broader Developmental-CFE ecology step; do not jump automatically to K-dose.
preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_BRANCH_IF_NOT_SUPPORTED: Do not rescue by tuning. Re-rank update-field/horizon and primitive-interface hypotheses.

hard_prohibitions: No joint numeric-state+mode -> action training example may appear in either arm.
No condition_z may be supplied in the composed primary evaluation.
No semantic overflow/action words may appear in opaque policy/composition learner-visible prompts.
No adaptive seed extension beyond the six frozen seeds.
No K1/K2/K4 or optimizer-window scientific screen may run in parallel.
No post-outcome change to margins, prompt contract, action mapping, thresholds, update-field mixture, or evaluation slices.
No result from this Identifying-CFE specialization may silently redefine Developmental CFE.
